details:
Here are some features I would love to see inside of the game! I think they would upgrade the social experience and allow extra things for players to use.

- 1. Add sounds to the chat system.

Adding sounds like, when you sent a message, when you get sent a message and much more, this gives a dynamic feeling to the chat system, meaning you can get reminded with a sound when someone sends a message in the game.

- 2. Notify player when someone tap's their shoulder.

This would help A LOT when trying to get someones attention in the game, especially PC Players where they don't have Phantom Touch and other things. Not only will this help Mutes, Players with Dysarthria and Hard-Hearing Players get others attention by just, Tapping on their shoulder like people do in real life.

- 3. Calling / Remote Messaging System.

Imagine wanting to talk to a friend, but their inside of a private instance and they can't invite you cause it's invite only. Adding a calling system and a messaging system to message your friends without using invites or joining worlds would be awesome, I would love to see VRChat players have a group chat, but staying inside of their home.

- 4. Multi-Platform Support.

Since Easy-Anti-Cheat was added to VRChat, it removed the support for Virtual Machines, and other applications to allow .EXE's to run on macOS, or Linux. or applications that port PC Games to Consoles like the PS4, Xbox One, Etc.
Adding support for these platform's and maybe even more would make this game way bigger, and more players on Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo Switch, Linux, MacOS, willing to buy VRChat+, But I'd rather just stick to adding Linux and MacOS support.

- 5. Custom VRChat+ Subscription Length's.
VRChat+ is only limited to 1 Month, and 1 Year Subscriptions, adding a custom slider to change the amount of months you want would be a big plus! (Get it, big plus.) Especially if you want to give your friend 3 Months instead of one of VRChat+

- 6. More Report Options.
Having more report options for reporting users would be great, especially add a report option specifically for underage players, or players cheating and breaking the rules. 

- 7. Post Processing for Quest Users.
Having Post Processing for Quest Users would be very good, and it would be very helpful for Quest Users to sleep in VR with a Sleeping Filter on.


Thats all I have for features, there might be more but this is all I could think of in 30 minutes, hope you like them!
title: 7 Feature Requests
